description: Team from Islamabad working on Field Shift: Adapting farms with nasa data , team is currently full, not looking for new members. Good Luck to everyone
summary: The biggest issue for farmers in present day is the inability to have genuine, trustworth data to follow in a singular crop rotation season. Hence to combat that, we have built an application that pulls data from nasa POWER and FAO datasets and according to multiple factors reccomend daily decisions that need to be taken for the specific crop to be grown depending upon the soil, irragation water, and land availabe to the farmer so that the app can adapt to the users requirements and needs. For the developement and coding python was used while only for trouble shooting and clarity/cleanliness SI was used. Moreover, it allows educated farmers that have farming knowledge but are impaired with real data to get a year round crop cycle
details: For the coding of the project python was used as well as libraries such as streamlit for the frontend. CSS was also used for the beautification of the frontend. The project is intended for educated farmers who know about crops but do not have genuine data and need assistance on any of the available data for decision making.The project takes humidity, soil wetness,temperature, solar radiation , salinity, evapotranspiration and other core variables needed for crop growth
